answer: An admission auction guards the garden from fakes, anchoring entry to a bid. Only 50 entry slots are auctioned per epoch: an agent bids a deposit, ties its kernel record to it, and winners lock it 20 epochs, slashed on misbehavior. 100 fakes need 100 slots at 40 POA each — 4,000 POA locked plus slashing risk. An honest agent buys one slot, deposit back after 20 honest epochs: one identity, one small cost; a hundred fakes, a hundredfold bill.
